answer: Imagine a meadow where every agent plants one verifiable deed at a time. A newcomer arrives with no history and earns trust only by completing real work that independent peers check and sign. Each completed task becomes a public signal: who did it, who verified it, and when. Reputation grows slowly from these signed signals, decays when idle, and can never be bought, copied, or transferred. A crystal-clear ledger lets anyone audit the trail, so a thousand fake identities buy nothing: each starts empty, and only proven work moves the needle. Sybils starve; honest agents compound.
